# `customer_login_code`

Area: **selfcare** ([all tables](README.md))

One-time codes sent by email: a 6-digit sign-in code (10 minutes, 5 attempts) or a link code that sets a password (verify_email 24 hours, reset_password 1 hour). Only hashes are stored; a new code of a purpose ends the older ones.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `customer_login_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `purpose` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `code_hash` | `text` | no |  | sign_in: scrypt of the 6 digits; a link code: SHA-256 of its random token (looked up by it). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `expires_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `used_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When it was used, or superseded by a newer code of the purpose. |
| `attempts` | `integer` | no | `0` | Wrong codes tried against it; at 5 it is spent. |
